title: Staged Adoption Playbook — CS Kickstart (Day 0–90)
content:
Purpose:
This is a working playbook for CS to run a staged 0–90 day adoption program ("kickstart") that scales across self-serve and POC accounts. Focus is fast time-to-first-value (TTFV) + clear renewal signals. Not final; meant to capture experiments, checklist, and tracking hooks for pilots.

Who this doc is for:
- CS AEs and CSMs running initial onboarding wave (PLG and self-serve turned high-value)
- Solutions eng for technical setup and health checks
- Growth & Product for telemetry and activation experiments

High-level goals (North Star):
1) Customer reaches first stable inference pipeline in <= 21 days for Dedicated/Hosted and <= 7 days for sandbox trial.
2) 3 activation events within 30 days (test inference, eval harness run, dashboard check-in).
3) Renewal-ready signals surfaced by day 75 for accounts heading to commit.

Success metrics (measured):
- TTFV (days) — week-by-week cohort
- 30/60/90 adoption score (0–100) combining API calls, models pinned, evals completed, dashboards viewed
- Conversion to paid / committed capacity within 90 days
- CSAT at day 30 and day 90

Phase breakdown (staged):
Phase A: Kickoff + Infrastructure (Day 0–14) — primary objective: green infra + first request
- Prep:
  - Account intake form filled (AE) — include expected throughput, compliance/regulatory notes, region preference
  - Create tenant + apply access controls (IAM/KMS stub) — SE owner
  - Provision test keys + one-sentence quickstart for devs (link to hosted SDK snippet)
- Tasks:
  - Quick API smoke test (SE) — succeed >=1 generation within env
  - Dashboard access invited (CS)
  - Export baseline latency/cost estimate (ops template)
- Communications cadence:
  - Kickoff call w/ AE, CSM, SE within 72 hours of signup
  - Slack channel created: #kick-<customer-shortname>
- Risks & mitigations:
  - Risk: billing/permission delays -> Mitigation: temporary dev token + guidance doc
  - Risk: customer infra blocked (VPC) -> Mitigation: checklist for network allowlist + template request to infra team

Phase B: Adoption & Instrumentation (Day 15–45) — primary objective: customer runs repeatable workload and sees cost/latency metrics
- Prep:
  - CS creates adoption playbook tailored to workload type (chat, embeddings, rerank)
- Tasks (examples):
  - Run three example prompts and capture embeddings/gen traces (customer + SE)
  - Set up automated eval harness (product evals repo link) and baseline quality metric
  - Add key dashboards: token breakdown, per-model latency, error rates
  - Run 1 optimization experiment: enable prefix caching or switch to recommended quantized variant
- Communications cadence:
  - Weekly 30-min check-ins (CS + SE)
  - Monthly exec summary prep if account > $10k MRR potential
- Signals of momentum:
  - Sustained daily calls > threshold
  - Successful eval pass with quality >= baseline
  - Dashboard viewed by product/engineering stakeholders
- Risks & mitigations:
  - Risk: quality regressions after optimization -> Mitigation: revert plan + A/B revert runbook (linked)

Phase C: Value Realization & Renewal Prep (Day 46–90) — primary objective: customer demonstrates business outcomes and shows intent to commit
- Tasks:
  - Business impact doc co-created with AE (expected cost savings, latency gains, throughput improvements)
  - Run scaled load test (ops & SE) to validate SLA needs
  - Identify renewal owner and create renewal tracker row (link to gsheet)
  - Set renewal trigger flags: usage sustained 14 days, evals passed, champion engaged
- Communications:
  - Week-of demo to internal exec champion + presentation of business impact
  - QBR-lite at day 75 covering adoption score, risks, and recommended next step (dedicated capacity, contract options)
- Exit criteria for 90-day success:
  - Adoption score >= 70 OR clear business case + roadmap alignment
  - Renewal owner assigned and renewal conversation started
  - No P1 unresolved technical blocking issues

Operational artifacts (minimum viable kit):
- Account intake template (AE) — link above
- Onboarding checklist (SE + CS) — smoke tests, dashboard setup, eval harness link
- Renewal tracker row template (gsheet) — fields: ARR potential, adoption score, champion name, renewal date estimate, blocker log
- 30/60/90 email templates: kickoff, mid-adoption nudge, renewal intro (snippet below)

Experiment backlog (ideas to test):
- Auto-suggested prompts on first SDK use -> increases trial signal completion?
- One-click eval harness run from console -> reduces friction
- Incentivized early milestone (discount if commit within 90 days) -> test conversion lift

Risk register (top 5 live):
- Legal delay for Private deployment: mitigation - checklist + prioritized packet for legal review
- Network/VPC provisioning waiting >7 days: mitigation - temporary hosted fallback + offline demo package
- No internal technical champion: mitigation - AE to secure champion during week 1 kickoff

Small team responsibilities (recommended):
- CSM (primary): adoption plan owner, weekly cadence, adoption score update
- AE: business case owner, renewal negotiation lead
- SE: infra + eval harness implementation, P0 technical fixes
- Solutions Eng Ops: load test coordination, dedicated capacity sizing

Checklist (copyable for quick paste into meeting notes):
- Pre-kickoff: intake form done; tenant provisioned; dev key created
- Kickoff: confirm champion; invite dashboards; schedule weekly check-ins
- Week 2: first successful generation; baseline metrics recorded
- Week 4: eval harness run; optimization experiment scheduled
- Week 8: business impact doc draft; renewal tracker row created
- Week 10–12: exec demo; renewal conversation initiated

Open questions / decisions to make:
- Should we require a champion in AE handoff checklist or allow CSM to recruit? (TBD by pilot cohort)
- Discounting policy for early commit — need finance signoff (linked JIRA ticket)

Templates (snippets):
- Kickoff email subject: "Redwood Kickoff: <Customer Name> — Next steps and who to contact"
- Mid-adoption nudge: short checklist + link to three actions that impact adoption score
- Renewal intro script: ask about roadmap alignment, planned capacity growth, and procurement timeline

Immediate next steps (this doc owner):
1) Pilot this playbook with 5 accounts in February — track adoption score weekly (owner: Priya)
2) Create a GSheet template for renewal tracker and add pilot rows (owner: Jenna)
3) Draft a one-page exec-demo template for SE/AE to present (owner: Omar)

Notes to self / TODOs:
- Add sample eval harness commands and minimal reproducible example for embeddings use-case
- Tie adoption score to concrete console events (viewed onboarding guide, ran eval, invited teammate)
- Remove internal jargon before sharing with broader CS org

References and links:
- Confluence: CS-Onboarding-Framework-4872
- GitHub: github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding-examples (link stub)
- Sheet: renewal-tracker-template (see linked_artifacts)

Last updated notes:
- 2026-02-20: Added experiment backlog and tightened phase exit criteria.
- 2026-01-25: Initial draft and stakeholder sync with SE and AE leads.

(End of doc — working draft. Use as editable team artifact; push changes directly here or link PR to update shared templates.)
